versions.name: Kayaking
versions.description: Fit a life jacket, capsize on purpose and wet-exit safely, then run a buoyed course using forward, sweep, and draw strokes, and bring a swamped boat back with a kayak-over-kayak rescue.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
